title.narrative: Enhancing fisheries management and aquaculture development in Africa: a programme for accelerated reform in the sectors (FISHGOV2)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to improve food security, livelihoods and wealth creation in sustainable fisheries and aquaculture, aligned with AU Agenda 2063 The specific objectives are the following: 1.African Union decisions on sustainable fisheries and aquaculture policies are evidence based 2.Fisheries and aquaculture policies in Africa are coherent with the PFRS and other AU priorities and coordinated at continental, regional and national levels 3.Africa is adequately represented and effectively participates in international fisheries and aquaculture fora and ably domesticates relevant global instruments

description.narrative: The contribution of sustainable fisheries and aquaculture resources to the achievement of AU Agenda 2063 objectives notably in terms of food security, livelihoods and wealth creation enhanced
This indicator measures the average fish consumed per year in Kilograms. It is computed as total fish catch (in Kilograms) divided by the total population

comment.narrative: We expect the average to increase to at least 10.5 due to increases in apiculture production on the continent
The indicator is estimated at 9.94 kg per capita
